title: Provide a leased Wine Bluetooth backport
changes: Provide an opt-in validation wrapper that verifies its parent owns the managed leases and checks the local Bluetooth module and installed Wine hashes before mounting the matching upstream guard backport in a private namespace.
validation: Matching Wine 10 source and compiled module pass checksum, corrected-guard disassembly and exported ABI checks in wine-dbus-overlay-link-s10dafvr. Wine loader proofs v50bntvr and 25z4y70w initialize the module without the assertion and drain the server.

The affected Blue Screw scene in wine-dbus-overlay-reproducer-hrc9ivgq matches 600 frames without the D-Bus assertion and drains Wine. That unit reports FAIL because its trace parser mishandled a split openat; read-only reconciliation qxfzqz9z verifies the successful open and unchanged protected inputs.
limitations: The installed system module remains defective and ordinary Wine commands do not use the opt-in overlay. The exact D-Bus event, physical Bluetooth and asynchronous property updates remain unverified; source signatures were not independently authenticated. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements.
